column1: # promptinit against zsh 5.9.2's own copy: each row is a call and what the run
# printed, standard error on the same pipe, each newline written `~`, after
# `autoload -Uz promptinit add-zsh-hook; promptinit`, with the themes
# with /opt/homebrew/bin/zsh -f, PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, a HOME that does not exist
# and standard input on the null device. Rows whose text names a
# line of zsh's function file are left out.
prompt tiny; print -r -- "$PS1|$RPS1|$prompt_theme|${(k)functions[prompt_tiny_precmd]}"; print -r -- ${precmd_functions}; [[ -o promptsubst ]] && print subst

prompt tiny; prompt zap; print -r -- "$PS1|$RPS1|${precmd_functions}|$prompt_theme"; [[ -o promptbang ]] && print bang; [[ -o promptsubst ]] || print nosubst; [[ -o promptcr ]] || print nocr; [[ -o promptpercent ]] || print nopercent
PS1='orig> '; RPS1=r0; prompt zap; prompt restore; print -r -- "$PS1|$RPS1|$prompt_theme"; [[ -o promptbang ]] || print nobang
PS1='orig> '; prompt tiny; prompt zap; prompt restore; print -r -- "$PS1|$RPS1|${precmd_functions}|$prompt_theme"
